info.title: Financial Loss API Specification
info.description:
CyberCube's CyberConnect APIs deliver data and analytics solutions for the cyber insurance ecosystem. Our Financial Loss API helps you to understand risk at a deep level by generating loss metrics from the Financial Loss Model.

# First Steps
Before using the Portfolio Scoring API, read these short guides to understand the optimal workflows and other key details:

- [Export a Report](/financial-loss-apis/exporting-a-report)
- [General Error Codes](/api-management/api_user-general-error-codes?root=418)
- [Headers & Rate Limits](/api-management/headers-and-rate-?root=418)
- [Supported SIC-4 Codes](/financial-loss-apis/supported-sic-4-codes)


# Using This Swagger API Document
Use this Swagger API document to test your calls and generate Curl commands, request URLs, and server responses:
1. Click the **green Authorize** button, enter your API key, and click **Authorize**.
2. Expand any of the endpoint sections and click **Try it Out**.
3. If necessary, enter any IDs or other parameter values to make the call.
4. Click **Execute**.
5. View your results.

# Authentication
You must successfully authenticate to access and use our APIs. To authenticate, use the authentication key sent to you from our team. 

See [Access Your API Keys](/api-authentication-and-security/read-only-api-users?root=169) for more information.

post.description:
Run a Financial Loss Analysis using an `accountId`. Use the returned `analysisId` in other endpoints to get financial loss data and reports. 

***Note:*** This endpoint does not download the report or show the data. Wait at least **30 seconds** before exporting a report from the analysis.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: ID of the account to run the analysis on

get.description:
Search for available companies in our firmographic database. You can search by company name or website:

  - Searches for names and websites are not case-sensitive.
  - Website prefix (https:// or http://) is not required.
  - Searches return up to 50 matching company records.

post.description: Create a new account. Use the returned `accountId` in other endpoints to identify the account.

requestBody.description:
| Property | Description | Default / Other Accepted Values | Required
 | --- | --- | --- | --- |
 | `countryCode` | Country code for the company location | No default / String| Yes
 | `policyPremium` | Premium for the account (USD) | No default / Number | No
 | `sic4` | Standard Industrial Classification code | No default / See [Supported SIC-4 Codes](/financial-loss-apis/supported-sic-4-codes). | Yes
 | `eil` | Unique code that identifies the company in our Enterprise Intelligence Layer | No default / String| No
 | `companyName` | Company name | No default / String| Yes
 | `attachmentPoint` | Attachment point for the account (USD) | No default / Number | No
 | `recordsCount` | Number of records associated with the account | No default / Integer | No
 | `deductible` | Deductible for the account (USD) | No default / Number | No
 | `limits` | Policy limit for the account (USD) | No default / Number | No
 | `website` | Company website | No default / String | No
 | `participationPercentage` | Participation percentage for the account, expressed as a decimal, such as `0.75`. | No default / Number | No
 | `revenue` | Company revenue (USD) | No default / Number | No
 | `companySize` | Company size | `LARGE` / `MEDIUM`, `SMALL`, `MICRO` | Yes
 | `contractType` | Type of contract. | `Standalone Cyber` / `E&O`, `D&O`, `GL`, `Property`, `Cargo & Marine`, `Kidnap & Ransom`, `Aviation`, `Product Liability`, `Auto Liability`, `Fidelity`, `WC`, `Professional Liability`, `Commercial Crime`, `Other` | No
 
 **Note:** Optional parameters require empty strings or `null` values.
 
 # Coverage Properties
 
 Include or exclude coverages, set sublimit amounts, and set deductible amounts. Configure each nested property with the following values:
 
  - `include`: `true` / `false`
  - `sublimitAmount`: Number
  - `deductibleAmount`: Number
  - `deductibleType`: `Time` / `Franchise Time`
  
  See the table below to set the loss basis type and deductible types for `businessInterruption`, `contingentBusinessInterruption`, and `businessInterruptionLossBasis`.
 
 
 | Property | Description | Default / Other Accepted Values | Required
 | --- | --- | --- | --- |
 | `legalLiability` | Legal liability coverage | Included | No
 | `regulatoryFinesAndPenalties` | Regulatory fines and penalties coverage | Included | No
 | `investigationAndResponse` | Investigation and response coverage | Included | No
 | `dataRestoration` | Data Restoration coverage | Included | No
 | `businessInterruption` | Business interruption coverage | Included; `deductibleType`: `Time` / `Franchise Time` | No
 | `businessInterruptionLossBasis` | Loss basis calculation type for business interruption coverage | `lossBasisType`: `Revenue` / `Profit` | No
 | `contingentBusinessInterruption` | Contingent business interruption coverage | Included; `deductibleType`: `Time` / `Franchise Time` | No
 | `misdirectedPayment` | Misdirected payment coverage | Included | No
 | `extortionPayment` | Extortion payment coverage | Included | No
 
 
**Note:** Optional parameters require empty strings or `null` values.

get.summary: Download Financial Loss by Type Report
get.description:
Get a `preSignedUrl` to download a CSV report with financial loss data by type (RFA, baseline) by using an `accountId` and `analysisId`. Keep in mind that your `preSignedUrl` is valid for 5 minutes.

Download the report with a GET command and the `preSignedUrl`. See [Export a Report](/financial-loss-apis/exporting-a-report)  for example code.

**Note:** Wait at least 30 seconds before exporting a report from an analysis.
get.operationId: Get YLT presigned URL result by type (RFA, BASELINE)

get.description:
Use an `accountId` and `analysisId` to get financial loss data by type. Enter `Risk_Adjusted` or `Baseline` to determine the calculation type for the loss metrics:
  - Expected Loss
  - Average Frequency
  - Average Severity
  - Coefficient of Variation
  - Standard Deviation
  - Probability of Attachment
  - Probability of Exhaustion
  - Modelled Loss Ratio
get.operationId: Get financial loss by type (Risk Adjusted, Baseline)

get.description:
Get a `preSignedUrl` to download a CSV report with CAT financial loss data by using an `accountId` and `analysisId`. Keep in mind that your `preSignedUrl` is valid for 5 minutes.

Download the report with a GET command and the `preSignedUrl`. See [Export a Report](/financial-loss-apis/exporting-a-report)  for example code.

**Note:** Wait at least 30 seconds before exporting a report from an analysis.

Use an `accountId` and `analysisId` to get CAT financial loss data for an account:
  - Expected Loss
  - Average Frequency
  - Average Severity
  - Coefficient of Variation
  - Standard Deviation
  - Probability of Attachment
  - Probability of Exhaustion
  - Modelled Loss Ratio
